column1: # One row per gate: <gate name><TAB><16 hex digits>.
# The value is an FNV-1a hash of the SETTLED screen with the menu bar rows
# masked (the clock lives there). It answers "these exact pixels", where a
# boot etalon's luminance ratios answer only "this looks like a Finder".
# A gate with no row prints its measured value and passes: that printed
# line is what gets pasted here. A row of `-` leaves a profile unpinned on
# purpose. Changing a value is a deliberate act — the diff names the
# profile whose screen moved, and the commit says why.
